profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I love design, innovation, and creating things from scratch. I'm a software engineer focused on JavaScript and have experience with React, CSS, HTML, Node, SQL databases(MySQL/PostgreSQL) and noSQL database(MongoDB). I strive to build agile, modern, and responsive websites with clean and easy to read code through collaborative coding practices.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Lead developer for sponsored interactive articles for ad campaigns on CNN and Discovery.

positions.title: Associate Designer for Hurley Boys
positions.description:
•	Overseeing boy’s tops and newborn/infant categories from concept to production.
•	Partnering with the Design Operation and Technical Design teams to ensure timelines are met and the accuracy of tech packs. 
•	Managing the creation and maintenance of catalogs, reviewing fit samples with technical design team, and handling daily communication with the sample room.
•	Managing the creation of packaging and trim art pages and development with overseas vendor.

positions.title: Freelance design for Luxury Women's Activewear
positions.description:
•	Handled multiple responsibilities in a small women’s activewear start-up company, from supporting creative director with design details to all aspects of production for cut & sew and cashmere sweaters.
o	Managed creation of tech packs & catalogs.
o	Managed fitting and handling all aspects of communicating and troubleshooting with overseas office regarding sampling & production.

positions.title: Associate Designer for Nike Young Athlete Little
positions.description:
•	Oversaw Newborn and Infant categories for girls and boys from concept to production.
•	Managed planning outfits for Kids Rock Fashion Shows. Success was shown by over 1 billion impressions on social media and WGSN write up for Fall 2015 fashion show.
•	Trained junior team members on Color Library and workflow.

positions.title: Assistant Designer for Nike Young Athlete Little
positions.description:
•	Designed boys sets (Size: Infant to 7) influenced by the Nike Corporate adult line and gave direction to graphic artists for prints and graphics for Spring 2015 line.
•	Designed girls sets (Size: Infant to 6X) and gave direction to graphic artists for prints and graphics for Spring 2015, Fall 2015 and Spring 2016 line.
•	Supported the design team and contributed new ideas by putting together extensive trend research. 
•	Communicated with overseas sample room and production facilities on daily basis to ensure sales and production samples were made correctly.
•	Attended fit sessions with designers and tech designers.
•	Created new Color Library capability by organizing over 1,000 color standards into searchable physical and Excel databases.  Implemented new workflow leveraging Color Library for global production facilities that allowed for more efficient sample and production processes.  Made comments and approved lab dips from the overseas sample room to ensure all colors match the standards.

positions.title: Administrative assistant to creative directors
positions.description:
•	Handled sample and fabric budget approvals and created and managed sample charts.
•	Kept track of design expenses and generated monthly reports to be reviewed by creative directors. Created monthly individual expense reports.
•	Created design calendars in Adobe Illustrator and Excel. 
•	Contacted and arranged meetings with trend and color services companies.
